# MM-P3-L2-RR02-S3 Calibration checks - Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #2

Revision: Rev B
Plant: P3, line P3-L2
Equipment: EQ-P3-L2-RR02

Scope
This document defines the calibration check procedure for measuring and verifying radial positioning and diameter control on Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #2 (EQ-P3-L2-RR02). The procedure covers pre-check preparations, tools required, stepwise verification of measurement systems used to control ring diameter, acceptable tolerance verification, and recording requirements. This procedure complements operational and maintenance instructions contained in SOP-P3-L2-03, SOP-P3-L2-04, and SOP-P3-L2-05.

Background and rationale
Accurate radial positioning and outer diameter control are critical for product quality and mill longevity. Calibration checks reduce risk of producing out-of-spec forgings and support predictive maintenance by ensuring sensors, scales, and mechanical stops report true positions. The maximum ring outer diameter for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #2 (EQ-P3-L2-RR02) is 1415 mm; verification of measurement systems must demonstrate accurate performance across the usable range, including near the maximum value. Lubrication can affect mechanical backlash and sensor repeatability; use of the specified lubricant supports consistent behavior. The lubricant part number for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #2 (EQ-P3-L2-RR02) is CFW-LUB-930.

Tools
- Calibrated diameter master set suitable for ring rolling application and traceable to laboratory reference.
- Precision gap gauge set for contact checks.
- Portable linear encoder or laser displacement gauge with traceable calibration certificate.
- Surface condition inspection mirror and non-marring probe.
- Clean lint-free wipes and compatible cleaning solvent.
- Lubricant inventory label indicating CFW-LUB-930.
- Calibration log forms and digital capture device as specified in related SOPs SOP-P3-L2-03, SOP-P3-L2-04, SOP-P3-L2-05.

Procedure
Preparation
- Review the three related SOPs SOP-P3-L2-03, SOP-P3-L2-04, SOP-P3-L2-05 for safety, lockout-tagout, and operational context before beginning.
- Verify calibration status and traceability of all measurement tools. Do not proceed if any tool lacks a valid calibration certificate.
- Inspect mechanical surfaces and contact faces for damage, contamination, or wear. Clean contact areas with lint-free wipes and approved solvent.
- Confirm lubricant inventory and apply only the lubricant identified by part number CFW-LUB-930 to moving contact points where required by maintenance practice. Record lubricant application event on the calibration log.

Mechanical alignment and zero check
- Position the mill in a safe, verified idle state per SOP-P3-L2-03. Engage mechanical locks as required.
- Using the precision gap gauge set, perform a contact check at known reference points to confirm that physical stops and reference faces are free of debris and seated properly. Record any deviation observed between physical stop and gauge reading.
- Mount the portable linear encoder or laser displacement gauge to the designated reference bracket. Align measurement axis with the radial movement direction and perform a zeroing operation in accordance with the gauge manufacturer procedure.

Diameter verification
- Select an appropriate diameter master from the calibrated set that represents a target within the mill’s usable range; include at least one measurement near the maximum ring outer diameter. When using a master at the maximum ring outer diameter, ensure the master dimension does not exceed the maximum ring outer diameter for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #2 (EQ-P3-L2-RR02) is 1415 mm.
- Place the master on the roller path and bring the radial control into nominal contact following safe handling practices. Use non-marring probes to avoid surface damage.
- Record the instrument reading and compare to the master dimension. Note the absolute deviation, repeatability over three consecutive contacts, and any hysteresis observed when approaching from different directions.
- If deviations exceed the acceptance criteria in this document, follow corrective actions under “Acceptance criteria” before returning the mill to production.

Sensor and scale checks
- Inspect and verify encoder mounts and cable connections for secure attachment and absence of damage.
- Perform a dynamic check by moving the radial axis through the range of travel while observing the gauge output. Verify smooth output without jumps or noise indicative of electrical or mechanical faults.
- Check for consistent readings when returning to common reference points; log all results.

Lubrication influence check
- After initial measurements, apply the lubricant part number for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #2 (EQ-P3-L2-RR02) is CFW-LUB-930 to the specified contact points. Allow moving parts to settle, then repeat the diameter verification and sensor checks to observe any change in measurement behavior attributable to lubrication.
- Record before-and-after readings and comment on differences in repeatability, hysteresis, or offset.

Examples and rationale
- Example entry: master dimension 1415 mm used for verification at maximum perimeter. Instrument reading 1415 mm with repeatability within documented tolerance demonstrates acceptable performance at the design limit.
- Rationale: including a measurement near the maximum ring outer diameter for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #2 (EQ-P3-L2-RR02) is necessary because mechanical deflections and sensor performance can vary near travel limits.

Records to keep
- Complete calibration log including: tool serials and calibration certificate references, measurement master IDs, raw instrument readings, computed deviations, lubricant application records referencing CFW-LUB-930, technician name and signatures, and references to the related SOPs SOP-P3-L2-03, SOP-P3-L2-04, SOP-P3-L2-05.
- Attach supporting photographs or data files exported from portable instruments. Retain records in the document control system per plant retention policy.

Acceptance criteria
- Measurements must demonstrate consistent repeatability and agreement with calibrated masters across the usable range, including at or near the maximum ring outer diameter for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #2 (EQ-P3-L2-RR02) is 1415 mm.
- Sensor outputs must be smooth and free of intermittent errors during dynamic travel checks. Any persistent offset or erratic behavior requires repair or recalibration of the sensor or associated mechanical elements before returning equipment to service.
- Lubrication must be performed using the lubricant part number for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #2 (EQ-P3-L2-RR02) is CFW-LUB-930; deviations from this lubricant must be documented and approved through maintenance governance.
- Nonconforming results must be recorded and escalated according to SOP-P3-L2-04 for corrective action and SOP-P3-L2-05 for parts replacement authorization.

Revision and references
- This procedure must be reviewed in conjunction with SOP-P3-L2-03, SOP-P3-L2-04, SOP-P3-L2-05. All calibration activities shall be recorded in the plant document control system.
